checks.name: Passive email scanners cannot consume invites; actual clicks activate exact Admin and Member roles
Profile opt-in is explicit and attendee directory never returns CRM contacts
Social wall writes persist once across retries, reloads and two authenticated browsers
Reports reach Admin-only moderation; authors cannot restore a hidden post
Private one-to-one messaging persists across browsers and never appears on the social wall
Recovery safely switches an existing different-account session, refuses mismatched identity updates and accepts a fresh login
Organizer can save/reload a draft lunch edit without changing the published event information
Actual public site contains source program, day-specific lunches, ads and no notifications
